test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A running track consists of two straight parallel segments, each 120 m long, connected at both ends by semicircular arcs. The inner perimeter of the track is 504 m. If the track has a uniform width of 18 m throughout, find the outer perimeter (in m, rounded off to the nearest tens) of the track. Take π = 22/7
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Inner perimeter = 2 × straight + curved

⇒ 504 = 2×120 + curved ⇒ curved = 504 − 240 = 264

Curved = circumference of circle ⇒ 2πr = 264

⇒ r = 264 / (2π) = 264 / (44/7) = 42 m

Outer radius = 42 + 18 = 60 m

Outer curved length = 2π × 60 = (44/7) × 60 ≈ 377.14

Total outer perimeter = 240 + 377.14 ≈ 617

Rounded to nearest tens ⇒ **620 m**

**∴ Answer = 620 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Straight parts = 120 m each

Inner perimeter = 504 m

Width = 18 m

**Formula used:**

Perimeter = 2 × straight + circumference of circle

Circumference = 2πr

**Calculation:**

⇒ 504 = 240 + 2πr

⇒ 2πr = 264

⇒ r = 42 m

⇒ Outer radius = 42 + 18 = 60 m

⇒ Outer curved length = 2π × 60 = 377.14

⇒ Total outer perimeter = 240 + 377.14 ≈ 617

⇒ Rounded ≈ 620 m

**∴ The correct answer is 620 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Track Structure

Two straight lines + two semicircles = one full circle

Width Effect

Only radius changes; straight lengths remain same

Key Idea

Find inner radius first, then add width

Rounding

Round final answer to nearest tens
